actions.desc: The dragon exhales a blast of fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw  taking 98 (28d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. The dragons spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 22). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
- **3/Day Each:** Command, Hold Person, glyph of warding, Wall of Fire
